race.comment: With a hot early tempo on the cards, STREET ARTIST (7) will be licking his lips from the wide draw. He only got through late here two weeks ago when savaging the line to just miss after settling a mile off them. Doubt Lloyd misses the boat again. KIMBERLEY SECRETS (4) is an underrated mare from a strong country stable. She has been good in her two runs back both in town and is set to fire third-up. Keatings knows her well and her 3kg claim gets her in a treat. HARRY GOT STYLES (5) beat Kimberly home here two weeks ago when returning to somewhere near his best form. If they pour it on early as anticipated he could cause a headache late. SHE'S AN ARTIST (1) has proven frustrating for her supporters but clearly has her share of ability. Has jumped out well in readiness and 2 of her 3 wins have come fresh. CONFESS OUR DREAMS (6) had excuses fresh and drawn better this time with Berry sticking. Not dismissing.
